Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
September 23, 2008
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 600 Eucalyptus Avenue, Vista, CA
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
Recommended Action:
There are no presentations scheduled on this agenda.*3
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
PH1.
Amendment No. 4 to the Vista Redevelopment Plan (CC/CDC)
1.
Conduct a joint public hearing on the proposed Amendment No. 4 to the Vista Redevelopment Plan for the Vista Redevelopment Project and the certification of a final Environmental Impact Report (EIR) prepared in connection therewith, and take the following actions:
2.
Adopt Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2008- , approving and transmitting its report on the Vista Redevelopment Plan, Amendment No. 4, from the Commission to the City Council;
3.
Adopt Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2008- , certifying the Final EIR for the Vista Redevelopment Plan, Amendment No. 4; (Recommended action continued on following page)
4.
Adopt Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2008- , finding that the provision of low and moderate income housing outside the boundaries of the proposed amendment area will be of benefit to the project;
5.
Adopt Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2008- , declaring certain property located in the Vista Redevelopment Project Area to be in conformity with such plan and subject to Health and Safety Code Section 33399(g);
6.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , certifying the Final EIR for the Vista Redevelopment Plan, Amendment No. 4;
7.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , finding that the provision of low and moderate income housing outside the boundaries of the proposed amendment area will be of benefit to the project; and
8.
Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2008- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Adopting the Redevelopment Plan Amendment No. 4 for the Vista Redevelopment Project."
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
